scope.notes: Cross-cuts widget configuration UI, protected local API, read-only browser rendering, field projections, persistence/migrations, security controls, and bilingual docs; estimated 11-20 implementation/test/doc files.

integration.notes: Adds an internal read-only overlay API and consumes the existing application/domain projections; OBS connects through its standard browser source and no external service integration is needed.

infrastructure.notes: Capability hashes and independently managed widget configuration require durable PostgreSQL schema and a real Prisma migration.

knowledge.notes: Uses existing Fastify/PostgreSQL/vanilla JS patterns plus verified OBS browser-source behavior and bearer-token handling guidance.

risk.notes: A leaked capability can disclose one widget's public stream data; incorrect scoping, stale display, or UID/secret projection would create privacy and broadcast correctness issues, but revocation is immediate and access is local.

flags: Architectural review required for scoped capability and read-only projection.
Use real PostgreSQL integration tests for capability persistence/revocation.
Keep the overlay local and separate from FND-0 MVP baseline.
Second critique required by COMPLEX Spec Pipeline.
